annotations.title: Create a live day-of schedule (run of show)

description: Creates a Runsheet: a live, shareable schedule for an event day (wedding, shoot, conference, any timed run of show). Start from a template or send your own items. Returns a view-only link for guests and vendors and a private edit link for the planner. Keep the edit link secret: anyone with it can change the schedule.

who.description: Vendors or roles on this slot

template.description: Starter schedule. Ignored if items are given.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York. Default UTC.

name: runsheet_create
